blurb: Guests enjoy wine flights of 4 three-ounce pours from at least 8 dry and sweet wine options. The venue is outdoor only, adults 21+ only, with no children allowed. Private seating options include Cabanas, Vineyard Pergola, and heated Igloos with rental fees and minimum purchase requirements.
extraNote: 18% gratuity automatically added to Cabana, Pergola, and Igloo minimum purchases · Reservations can be rescheduled or cancelled for refund minus processing fee with 72 hours notice · No outside alcohol permitted on premises per Maryland law · In case of rain or inclement weather, reschedule or store credit offered for Cabanas and Igloos · No glitter, confetti, or items tied/taped to furnishings in Cabana, Pergola, or Igloo · Groups of 7 or more require advance notice and confirmation
